intents.rationale: No cordoned.log.dirs config exists; add to ServerLogConfigs/AbstractKafkaConfig/KafkaConfig, dynamic per-broker in DynamicBrokerConfig, validated against log.dirs or '*'.
Gate on IBP_4_3_IV0: reject dynamic set below it with ConfigException; ignore static value.
Add CordonedLogDirs to BrokerHeartbeatRequest (new version), send from BrokerLifecycleManager once caught up, store in controller.
Filter brokers without uncordoned dirs in controller placement; INVALID_REPLICATION_FACTOR if too few.
Reject AlterReplicaLogDirs to a cordoned dir with INVALID_REPLICA_ASSIGNMENT.
LogManager directory selection must skip cordoned dirs regardless of controller hint.
Add isCordoned to DescribeLogDirsResponse.json (new version), LogDirDescription, LogDirsCommand.
Register the two gauges in LogManager.

criteria.text: cordoned.log.dirs can be set dynamically per broker; values not in log.dirs (and not '*') are rejected; removing the entry uncordons.
Below 4.3-IV0, dynamic setting is rejected with a configuration error and static setting has no effect.
Heartbeats carry cordoned dirs after catch-up; controller reflects dynamic changes without restart.
Auto-placed creation avoids fully cordoned brokers and fails with INVALID_REPLICATION_FACTOR when too few remain.
Explicit assignment onto a fully cordoned broker returns INVALID_REPLICA_ASSIGNMENT.
Reassignment onto a fully cordoned broker returns INELIGIBLE_REPLICA.
AlterReplicaLogDirs to a cordoned directory returns INVALID_REPLICA_ASSIGNMENT.
Broker never creates a new replica in a cordoned directory even if the controller suggested it.
DescribeLogDirs returns per-directory cordoned state via LogDirDescription.isCordoned() and the tool prints it.
LogDirectoryCordoned and CordonedLogDirectoryCount metrics are registered and accurate.
Integration test cordons/uncordons via Admin on an embedded cluster and checks placement and errors.

tasks.summary: Implement KIP-1066 end to end as one PR. Order: config + MV gating; protocol JSON changes and LogDirDescription; LogManager cordon state/metrics/dir choice; broker heartbeat; controller storage and placement/validation; ReplicaManager alter-log-dirs check; tool output; then tests, updating existing tests broken by schema/constructor changes.
